set.body:
This is the final execution task, not infrastructure implementation.
Preconditions: all sibling repair/collector/mapping tasks and the matrix-ownership fix are complete. Select one clean committed candidate without absorbing unrelated work. Record commit/tree/provider/fixture hashes. Use the existing release driver with the repaired bounded test inventory; never run scalafimTestAll in one sbt JVM.
Run documentation synchronization, manifest/receipt checks, focused JVM/JS tests, adopted formatting/compiler checks, coverage, scalafimCompileAll, every supported test batch, and validate the fresh performance receipt. Supply independently verified exact-candidate CI/regeneration and branch-policy bundles. Keep every gate log and failure. If any source changes, invalidate affected evidence and rerun against the new candidate; pending is not passing.
Acceptance: report validator accepts a release_eligible=true report only when every required gate and external receipt matches the same clean candidate and no unexplained numerical/performance disagreement remains. Update the P4.4h ledger with result links for every original acceptance criterion and explicit supported platform exclusions. Record closure evidence on P4.4, Phase 4 and the parent epic only after their aggregate criteria pass. If any required result is unavailable, leave those milestones open with the exact blocker. A request to gather evidence is not permission to change GitHub policy or publish a release.
set.title: P4.4j: execute the clean-candidate release gates and close the acceptance ledger
